definition: a cheap place to sleep in shared rooms
description: A 3D-animated backpacker gets a room key at a small reception desk, climbs the stairs into a dorm full of bunk beds and other travelers, claims a free top bunk for ten euros, shares crisps with a bunk neighbor and later toasts mugs with the whole room.
transcript: Is this bed free? Yes! Take the top! Perfect! 10 euros! Welcome! We all share!
